h.hypothesis: Prioritizing inspection of open surfaces before checking the semantically likely but costly-to-open fridge reduces total action steps for locating perishable food items compared to semantic-priority search.

probe_summary.evidence_goal: Total number of navigation and inspection actions required to locate the target object compared to baseline semantic-priority strategies.
probe_summary.local_function: Search for and acquire the target egg object.
probe_summary.realization_pattern: Open-surface-first traversal: exhaustively check all non-container receptacles before initiating container-opening actions.
stop_conditions: All open surfaces inspected without finding target (fallback to closed storage)

h.scope: ALFWorld kitchen tasks where the target is a perishable food item (e.g., egg) and the environment contains mixed open surfaces (countertops, shelves) and closed storage units (fridge, cabinets).

observed_search_acquisition_trajectory.endpoint_scope: target_acquisition_only; downstream task transformations/placement not asserted
